branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: Camelait Premium Ice Cream from Al Ain Dairy in the UAE, made from fresh camel milk with sauce ripples or nut pieces added. The company says camel milk's complex proteins made pasteurisation hard, and that it solved this in development.
